hero.description: I build Telegram WebApps and native Android apps via Capacitor — from first commit to Google Play. Frontend at Loov.

about.title: About
about.text: I work across web and mobile: React, TypeScript, Capacitor. Architecture → code → review → ship. I use Claude Code and MCP servers to automate the routine — so the time goes into what actually matters: the product.

one.title: From first commit to production
one.body: I take the task end to end: architecture, code, review, deploy. No handoffs between «the frontend dev who wrote it» and «the frontend dev who fixes it».

two.title: Web and mobile are one product
two.body: A React + Vite PWA becomes a native Android app via Capacitor: one codebase, biometrics, push notifications, Google Play.

three.title: Architecture you can maintain
three.body: FSD on the frontend, BFF on the backend, monorepo for multi-app setups. So that six months later the code is readable, not «let's burn it down and rewrite».

four.title: AI as a co-author, not magic
four.body: I use Claude Code and MCP servers for the routine: boilerplate, reviews, migrations, docs. Decisions and the product stay with me.

contacts.title: Let's talk
contacts.subtitle: Open to projects: Telegram WebApps, native Android via Capacitor, admin panels. Drop me an email — I'll get back to you.
